title: Count Vowel Substrings of a String
description:
[Source: LeetCode 2062]
A substring is a contiguous (non-empty) sequence of characters within a string. A vowel substring is a substring that only consists of vowels ('a', 'e', 'i', 'o', and 'u') and has all five vowels present. Return count of vowel substrings.

Input Format:
A string word

Output Format:
Vowel substrings count
